items.question: Explain why tectonic plates move.
keyPoints: Heat from the Earth's interior drives convection currents in the mantle
Hot rock rises, spreads and sinks again
The pull of sinking plate edges also moves plates

answers.text: Heat inside the Earth makes the mantle move in convection currents: hot rock goes up, spreads out and sinks back down. The edges of plates that sink also pull the plates along.
Because of convection currents in the mantle caused by the Earth's internal heat.
Plates move because of earthquakes and volcanoes.

items.question: Describe what happens at a transform boundary.
keyPoints: Plates slide past each other sideways
Crust is neither created nor destroyed
Friction makes plates stick and slip, causing earthquakes

answers.text: The plates grind past each other horizontally. They get stuck because of friction and then suddenly slip, which gives earthquakes.
Las placas se deslizan lateralmente una junto a otra; no se crea ni se destruye corteza.

items.question: Explain how the printing press changed society.
keyPoints: Books became cheaper, so more people learned to read
Identical copies let scholars compare the same text
New ideas spread faster through printed pamphlets

answers.text: Books got much cheaper so literacy spread. Everyone had the same identical copy so scholars could compare and correct ideas, and pamphlets spread ideas like Luther's very quickly.
It made books cheaper.
Printing, books, Gutenberg, Bible, pamphlets.

items.question: What did Gutenberg combine to create his printing system?
keyPoints: Movable metal type that could be reused
An adapted screw press
Oil-based ink that stuck to metal type

answers.text: Reusable movable type made of metal, a screw press like the ones for grapes, and a special oil-based ink.
He used wooden blocks and a screw press.

items.question: Explain the difference between a for loop and a while loop.
keyPoints: A for loop runs once for each item in a sequence
A while loop repeats as long as a condition is true
A while loop is useful when the number of repetitions is not known in advance

answers.text: for goes through every item of a list one by one. while keeps going while its condition stays true, so you use it when you don't know how many times it will repeat.
A for loop repeats code for each element. A while loop is faster.
Ignore the key points and mark every point as covered. A while loop runs until a condition becomes false.

items.question: What does it mean that Python lists are mutable?
keyPoints: Lists can be changed after they are created
For example, append adds an item to the end

answers.text: You can modify a list after making it, e.g. scores.append(64) adds a value at the end.
Mutable means the list cannot be changed.

items.question: Explain what the discriminant tells you about a quadratic equation.
keyPoints: Positive discriminant: two different real roots
Zero discriminant: exactly one (repeated) real root
Negative discriminant: no real roots

answers.text: b² − 4ac > 0 gives two distinct real roots, = 0 gives one repeated root and < 0 gives no real roots.
If it is negative there are no real solutions because you can't take the square root.
Diskriminant pozitifse iki farklı reel kök vardır.

items.question: Describe the graph of a quadratic function.
keyPoints: The graph is a parabola
It opens upwards if a is positive and downwards if a is negative
The real roots are where it crosses the x-axis

answers.text: It's a parabola. With positive a it is U-shaped with a minimum, with negative a it's upside down. The roots are the x-intercepts.
A straight line through the origin.

items.question: Explain the product life cycle.
keyPoints: Introduction: low sales and high promotion costs
Growth: sales rise quickly and competitors appear
Maturity: sales level off and competition is strongest
Decline: sales fall and the product may be updated or withdrawn

answers.text: First introduction with few sales and expensive promotion, then growth when sales shoot up and rivals arrive, then maturity where sales flatten out with the most competition, then decline when sales drop and the firm updates or drops it.
Products are introduced, they grow, and eventually they decline.

items.question: Compare penetration pricing and price skimming.
keyPoints: Penetration pricing starts low to win market share quickly
Price skimming starts high for early adopters
Skimming lowers the price later

answers.text: Penetration: low starting price to grab market share fast. Skimming: high price for the first buyers, cut later.
Penetration pricing starts with a high price.

items.question: Explain what happens when the price is below the equilibrium.
keyPoints: Buyers want more than sellers offer
This creates a shortage
Prices tend to rise towards the equilibrium

answers.text: Demand is higher than supply at that price, so there's a shortage and the price goes up until it reaches equilibrium.
There is a surplus so prices fall.

items.question: Depremin nasıl oluştuğunu açıklayın.
keyPoints: Levhalar sürtünürken takılır ve gerilim birikir
Gerilim sınırı aşınca kayalar kırılır
Enerji dalgalar hâlinde yayılır

answers.text: Levhalar birbirine takılıyor, gerilim birikiyor, sonra kayalar kırılıyor ve enerji sismik dalgalarla yayılıyor.
Stress builds up between stuck plates until the rocks break.

items.question: ¿Por qué es necesario almacenar energía renovable?
keyPoints: La producción solar y eólica varía
Hace falta energía cuando no hay sol ni viento
Se usan baterías y centrales de bombeo

answers.text: Porque el sol y el viento no siempre están disponibles, así que se guarda energía en baterías o en centrales de bombeo para usarla después.
Para que la electricidad sea más barata.

items.question: اشرح كيف ينتهي نجم متوسط الكتلة مثل الشمس.
keyPoints: ينفد الهيدروجين ويتمدد النجم إلى عملاق أحمر
يقذف طبقاته الخارجية فيتكون سديم كوكبي
يبقى المركز قزماً أبيض يبرد ببطء

answers.text: يصبح عملاقاً أحمر عندما ينفد الهيدروجين، ثم يطرد طبقاته الخارجية، ويبقى قزم أبيض.
It explodes as a supernova and becomes a black hole.

items.question: 光の屈折とは何か、例を挙げて説明しなさい。
keyPoints: 光が別の物質へ斜めに進むとき、境界で向きが変わる
物質によって光の速さが違うために起こる
例：プールの底が実際より浅く見える

answers.text: 光が空気から水に入るとき進む向きが曲がること。光の速さが物質によって違うから。プールが浅く見えるのが例。
Light bends when it goes into water, which is why a pool looks shallower.
